learn.hook: Amma draws a rangoli with dots and lines. Can you copy it and name its shapes?
points: A rangoli can be copied on a dot grid: join the same dots in the same way.
Rangolis have shapes like squares, triangles, rectangles and circles. Name each one.
Lines can be straight or curved. A straight line does not bend. A curved line bends.
A straight line is the shortest path between two dots.
We can also make a rangoli by tracing round bangles, lids and shape cut-outs.

example.q: Two dots are joined by a straight line and by a wavy curve. Which is shorter?
steps: The curve bends and goes a longer way.

learn.reallife: When you take a short cut straight across a field instead of going round, you are using the shortest path.

games.title: Rangoli facts
items: A straight line is the shortest way between two points.
Any bend makes the path longer.
Tracing round a bangle gives a square.
To copy a rangoli on a dot grid, join the same dots.
Then the shapes come out the same.
A triangle is made of curved lines.

quiz.q: Which is the shortest way from dot A to dot B?
quiz.explain: A straight line goes directly, without bending, so it is the shortest.

quiz.q: Which of these is a curved line?
quiz.explain: A round plate has a curved rim.

quiz.q: Amma traces round a round steel lid. What shape does she draw?
quiz.explain: A round lid gives a circle.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every lid makes a square

quiz.q: A rangoli has 2 squares, 4 triangles and 1 circle. How many shapes in all?
Meera copies a rangoli on a dot grid. What must she do to get the same picture?
options: Join the same dots in the same way
quiz.explain: Joining the same dots gives the same lines and shapes.

quiz.q: Which shape has only straight lines?
quiz.explain: A triangle has 3 straight sides.

quiz.q: How many straight lines make a square in a rangoli?
quiz.explain: A square has 4 straight sides.

quiz.q: Raju traces round a matchbox lying flat. What shape does he get?
quiz.explain: The flat face of a matchbox is a rectangle.

teach.ask: Gappu wants to fly from one tree to another by the shortest way. What path should he take?
teach.praise: A straight line, no bends! Chirp!
teach.nudge: Should my path be curved or straight?

learn.hook: Look at a roti, a samosa and a carrom board. Each one is hiding a flat shape!
points: Flat shapes that we can draw on paper are called 2D shapes.
A circle is perfectly round, like a roti or a bangle.
A triangle has 3 straight sides, like the front of a samosa.
A square has 4 equal sides and 4 square corners. A rectangle has 4 square corners, with 2 long sides and 2 short sides.
The flat faces of solid shapes are 2D shapes: each face of a dice is a square.

example.q: Name the shape of a ₹5 coin, a carrom board and a door.
steps: The coin is round all the way: a circle.
The carrom board has 4 equal sides: a square.
The door has 2 long sides and 2 short sides: a rectangle.

learn.reallife: Rangoli designs, windows, kites, tiles and chapatis are all full of 2D shapes.

games.title: Match the thing to its shape

quiz.q: A roti is shaped like a ___.
quiz.explain: A roti is round all the way around, with no corners. That is a circle.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the name of the round shape

quiz.q: Which shape has 3 straight sides?
quiz.explain: 'Tri' means three. A triangle has 3 straight sides.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up a triangle with a 4-sided shape

quiz.q: A carrom board has 4 equal sides and 4 square corners. What shape is it?
quiz.explain: 4 equal sides with square corners make a square.
quiz.mistake: Does not count the sides before naming the shape

quiz.q: A door has 2 long sides, 2 short sides and 4 square corners. What shape is it?
quiz.explain: A shape with 4 square corners and 2 long and 2 short sides is a rectangle.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every 4-sided shape is a square

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT a flat (2D) shape?
quiz.explain: A cube is a solid shape you can hold, like a dice. The others are flat shapes.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up flat shapes with solid shapes

quiz.q: Aisha puts a dice on paper and draws around one face. What shape does she get?
quiz.explain: Every face of a dice is a square, so the drawing is a square.
quiz.mistake: Names the solid shape instead of the shape of its face

quiz.q: Each cell of a honeycomb has 6 sides. What is a 6-sided shape called?
quiz.explain: A shape with 6 sides is a hexagon. A pentagon has 5 sides.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up hexagon (6 sides) and pentagon (5 sides)

quiz.q: Which shape has no corners at all?
quiz.explain: A circle is one smooth curved line, so it has no corners.
quiz.mistake: Does not notice that the other shapes have corners

teach.ask: Gappu thinks a door and a carrom board are the same shape. Can you tell him the difference?
teach.praise: The carrom board is a square and the door is a rectangle! Now I see it.
teach.nudge: Are all the sides of a door the same length?

learn.hook: Open up an empty sweet box and lay it flat. What shapes appear?
points: When we open and flatten a box, we see the shapes of all its faces. This flat shape is called a net.
A cuboid box has 6 faces. They are rectangles, and some may be squares. They are never triangles.
Fold the 4 corners of a square paper to the middle to make an envelope.
Roll a paper sheet to make a cylinder. Roll a quarter circle to make a cone.
Fold a net along its lines to make a cube or a cuboid.

example.q: Raju traces all the faces of a toothpaste box. How many shapes does he draw and what are they?

learn.reallife: Pizza and sweet boxes come flat from the factory and are folded into boxes at the shop.

games.title: Box facts
items: Top, bottom, front, back and two sides.
A face of a cuboid can be a triangle.
Its faces are rectangles or squares.
Rolling a paper sheet can make a cylinder.
Join the two edges after rolling.
A flattened cuboid box shows circles.

games.title: Make it from paper
pairs: Roll a sheet and join edges
Fold square corners to the middle

quiz.q: How many faces does a cuboid box have?
quiz.explain: A cuboid has 6 faces.

quiz.q: What shape are the faces of a cuboid?
quiz.explain: Every face of a cuboid is a rectangle (some may be squares).

quiz.q: Which shape can NEVER be a face of a cuboid?
quiz.explain: A cuboid's faces have 4 square corners. A triangle has only 3 corners.
quiz.mistake: Thinks any shape can be a face

quiz.q: Riya rolls a sheet of paper and joins the two edges. What does she make?
quiz.explain: A rolled sheet makes a tube: a cylinder.

quiz.q: How many square faces does the net of a cube have?
quiz.explain: A cube has 6 faces, all squares.

quiz.q: Which fold helps make an envelope from a square paper?
options: Fold the four corners to the middle
quiz.explain: Folding the corners to the centre makes a closed envelope.

quiz.q: A cube is opened and flattened. Each face is a square. How many corners does each face have?
quiz.explain: A square has 4 corners.
quiz.mistake: Counts the corners of the whole cube

quiz.q: A shoe box face is traced 2 times for the top and bottom, 2 times for front and back, and 2 times for the sides. How many tracings?

teach.ask: Gappu opened a cardboard box flat. He sees lots of shapes. What are they and how many?
teach.praise: Six rectangle faces, no triangles! Chirp!
teach.nudge: What shape are the faces of a box?

learn.hook: Doors, books, phones and blackboards. Rectangles are everywhere!
points: A rectangle has 4 sides and 4 corners. All 4 corners are square corners.
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal: the two long sides match and the two short sides match.
We can make a rectangle with 4 sticks: 2 long sticks of the same length and 2 short sticks of the same length.
On a dot grid, we can draw rectangles of many sizes, standing up, lying down or tilted.
To count rectangles in a picture, count the small ones and also the bigger ones made by joining them.

example.q: A rectangle is split into 2 parts by one line down the middle. How many rectangles can you see?

learn.reallife: A cricket pitch, a door and a ludo board's long paths are all rectangles.

games.title: Rectangle facts
items: Every corner of a rectangle is a square corner.
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
Long matches long, short matches short.
A tilted rectangle is still a rectangle.
Turning does not change the shape.
Any 4 sticks always make a rectangle.
We need 2 pairs of equal sticks and square corners.

quiz.q: How many sides does a rectangle have?
quiz.explain: A rectangle has 4 sides.

quiz.q: A rectangle's long side is 8 cm. How long is the opposite side?
quiz.explain: Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.

quiz.q: Which 4 sticks can make a rectangle?
options: 2 sticks of 6 cm and 2 sticks of 3 cm
quiz.explain: A rectangle needs 2 equal long sides and 2 equal short sides.

quiz.q: A rectangle is split into 3 parts in a row. How many rectangles in all?
quiz.explain: 3 small + 2 made of two parts + 1 whole = 6.

quiz.q: Which is NOT true for a rectangle?
quiz.explain: A rectangle has 4 sides, not 3.

quiz.q: Sohan draws a rectangle tilted on a dot grid. Is it still a rectangle?
options: Yes, turning does not change it
quiz.explain: A tilted rectangle still has 4 square corners and equal opposite sides.

quiz.q: Total length of sticks for a rectangle with sides 5 cm and 3 cm?
How many corners do 2 rectangles have together?

teach.ask: Gappu has 4 sticks: two long and two short. How can he make a rectangle?
teach.praise: Long opposite long, short opposite short, square corners! Chirp!
teach.nudge: Where should the two long sticks go?

learn.hook: A carrom board, a chessboard square and a roti tawa... wait, one of these is not a square!
points: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 square corners.
A square is a special rectangle: its long and short sides are the same length.
We can draw bigger squares around a small square on a dot grid.
To count squares in a figure, count small squares and bigger ones. A 2 by 2 grid has 4 small + 1 big = 5 squares.
Joining squares side by side makes new shapes: 2 squares make a rectangle; 3 squares make a line or an L.

example.q: How many squares are in a 2 by 2 grid?

learn.reallife: Chess and ludo boards are made of many small squares that form one big square.

quiz.q: A square has one side of 5 cm. How long are the other sides?
quiz.explain: All 4 sides of a square are equal.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a square is like a rectangle with different sides

quiz.q: How many squares in a 2 by 2 grid?
quiz.explain: 4 small squares + 1 big square = 5.

quiz.q: How many squares in a 3 by 3 grid?
quiz.explain: 9 small, 4 of size 2 by 2, and 1 big: 9 + 4 + 1 = 14.

quiz.q: Which shape is a square?
options: A shape with 4 equal sides and 4 square corners
A shape with 2 long and 2 short sides
quiz.explain: That is the meaning of a square.

quiz.q: Join 2 equal squares side by side. What shape do you get?
quiz.explain: 2 squares in a row make a rectangle that is twice as long as it is wide.
quiz.mistake: Thinks two squares make a bigger square

quiz.q: How many different shapes can 3 equal squares make, joined side to side?
quiz.explain: A straight line of 3, or an L. Turning does not make a new shape.

quiz.q: A square has sides of 4 cm. What is the total length of all sides?
Is every square a rectangle?
options: Yes, it has 4 square corners and opposite sides equal
quiz.explain: A square has everything a rectangle needs, and its sides are also all equal.
quiz.mistake: Thinks squares and rectangles are separate

quiz.q: On a dot grid, Asha draws a 1 by 1 square. Then she draws a bigger square around it, one dot further out on every side. What size is the new square?
quiz.explain: Going one dot out on the left and one on the right adds 2 to the width: 1 + 2 = 3. The same happens up and down, so the new square is 3 by 3.
steps: 1 dot out on each side adds 1 + 1 = 2
quiz.mistake: Adds only one dot in all, forgetting that both sides grow

teach.ask: Gappu found a shape with 4 sides. How can he tell if it is a square?
teach.praise: All sides equal and all corners square. It is a square! Chirp!
teach.nudge: What must be true about its sides and its corners?

learn.hook: Count the corners of your notebook. You can name many shapes just by counting!
points: A side is a straight line along the edge of a flat shape.
A corner is where two sides meet.
A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners. A square and a rectangle have 4 sides and 4 corners.
A pentagon has 5 sides and 5 corners. A hexagon has 6 sides and 6 corners.
A circle has no straight sides and no corners.

example.q: How many sides do 2 triangles and 1 square have altogether?

learn.reallife: When you make shapes with matchsticks or ice-cream sticks, each stick is one side.

quiz.q: How many corners does a triangle have?
quiz.explain: A triangle has 3 sides, and they meet at 3 corners.

quiz.q: How many sides does a pentagon have?
quiz.explain: A pentagon has 5 sides, like the outline of a simple house drawing.

quiz.q: Which shape has 6 sides and 6 corners?
quiz.explain: A hexagon has 6 sides and 6 corners.

quiz.q: Joseph made a shape with 4 matchsticks of the same length and 4 square corners. What shape did he make?
quiz.explain: 4 equal sides with square corners make a square.
quiz.mistake: Does not match the number of sticks to the number of sides

quiz.q: Riya makes 3 separate triangles with sticks, one stick for each side. How many sticks does she need?
quiz.explain: Each triangle needs 3 sticks. 3 + 3 + 3 = 9 sticks.
quiz.mistake: Counts the triangles instead of their sides

quiz.q: How many corners does a circle have?
quiz.explain: A circle has no straight sides, so no sides meet to make a corner. It has 0 corners.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the round edge has a corner somewhere

quiz.q: Meena counts the corners of a square and a triangle together. How many corners does she count?
quiz.explain: A square has 4 corners and a triangle has 3. 4 + 3 = 7.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a triangle has 4 corners too

quiz.q: A shape with straight sides has 5 corners. How many sides does it have?
quiz.explain: In a shape with straight sides, the number of sides is the same as the number of corners. So it has 5 sides.
quiz.mistake: Thinks sides and corners must be different numbers

teach.ask: Gappu drew a shape and wants to know its name. What should he count?
teach.praise: 3 sides and 3 corners, it's a triangle! Counting is magic!
teach.nudge: What two things can I count on my shape?

learn.hook: Fold a paper twice and you get a magic corner tester. Let us test the classroom!
points: The corners of a square and of a rectangle are all square corners.
Fold a paper in half, then in half again. The folded corner is a square corner tester.
Two paper strips joined at one end can open to show a smaller corner, a square corner or a bigger corner.
Hold the tester on a corner of a book, a table or the board. If it fits exactly, it is a square corner.
Sort corners: less than, equal to, or more than a square corner.

example.q: Leela opens two paper strips very little. Is the corner smaller or bigger than a square corner?
steps: A little opening makes a sharp, narrow corner.

learn.reallife: Carpenters check that cupboard and door corners are square, so the doors close properly.

games.title: Corner checks
items: All corners of a rectangle are square corners.
That is true for every rectangle.
A triangle can have 3 square corners.
A triangle can have at most one square corner.
Folding a paper twice makes a square corner tester.
The fold lines meet at a square corner.
The corner of a blackboard is a square corner.

quiz.q: How many square corners does a rectangle have?
quiz.explain: All 4 corners of a rectangle are square corners.
quiz.mistake: Thinks only some corners are square

quiz.q: How do you make a square corner tester?
options: Fold a paper in half and in half again
quiz.explain: The two folds meet at a square corner.

quiz.q: The tip of a samosa is sharp. Compared to a square corner, it is…
quiz.explain: A sharp tip is narrower than a square corner.

quiz.q: Clock hands at 3 o'clock make which corner?
quiz.explain: At 3 o'clock, the hands make a square corner.

quiz.q: Which object has ONLY square corners?
quiz.explain: A notebook is a rectangle, so all 4 corners are square.

quiz.q: Two paper strips are opened very wide, like a fan. The corner is…
quiz.explain: Opening wide makes a corner bigger than a square corner.

quiz.q: Ravi tests the corners of a triangle with his tester. One corner fits exactly. What kind is it?
quiz.explain: If the tester fits exactly, it is a square corner.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a triangle has no square corner

quiz.q: A square and a rectangle together have how many square corners?

teach.ask: Gappu wants to know if the corner of his nest box is a square corner. How can he check?
teach.praise: I folded a paper twice and it fits the corner exactly! Chirp!
teach.nudge: How do I make something to test the corner with?

learn.hook: 10 matchsticks, 3 squares. Can you do it before your friend?
points: On a dot grid, join 4 dots to make squares of different sizes: 1 by 1, 2 by 2 and bigger.
3 squares in a row share sides, so they need only 10 matchsticks, not 12.
12 matchsticks can make a 2 by 2 grid: that has 4 small squares and 1 big square, 5 in all.
Two triangles that share one side need only 5 sticks. Two separate triangles need 6.
Moving sticks lets you change one shape into another. Shared sides save sticks.

example.q: How many matchsticks make 3 squares in a row?
steps: Each next square shares a side: 3 sticks each.

learn.reallife: Matchstick puzzles are a favourite on long train journeys!

games.title: Puzzle facts
items: A 2 by 2 matchstick grid has 5 squares.
Separate squares need 12; 10 is when they share sides.
On a dot grid we can make squares of different sizes.
One stick works for two shapes.

quiz.q: How many matchsticks make 2 squares side by side (sharing a side)?
quiz.explain: 4 for the first, 3 more for the second: 7.

quiz.q: With 10 matchsticks, how many squares can you make in a row?
quiz.explain: 4 + 3 + 3 = 10 gives 3 squares.

quiz.q: 12 matchsticks make a 2 by 2 grid. How many squares are there?
quiz.explain: 4 small + 1 big = 5.

quiz.q: How many matchsticks for 2 SEPARATE triangles?
Two triangles share one side. How many matchsticks are used?
quiz.explain: 3 for the first triangle and 2 more for the second: 5.

quiz.q: On a 3 by 3 dot grid (3 rows of 3 dots), what is the biggest square you can make?
quiz.explain: 3 dots in a row have 2 gaps, so the biggest square is 2 by 2.

quiz.q: Separate squares need 4 sticks each. How many for 3 separate squares?
quiz.mistake: Shares sides that are not shared

quiz.q: Why do 3 squares in a row need fewer than 12 sticks?
quiz.explain: Inside sides are shared by two squares, so 2 sticks are saved.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a square has fewer sides

quiz.q: Ravi makes a triangle with 3 matchsticks. 2 more sticks lie beside it. He moves those 2 sticks so they make a second triangle that shares one side with the first. What does he have now?
quiz.explain: The 2 moved sticks and one side of the first triangle close up a new triangle. So there are 2 triangles, and still only 5 sticks.
steps: Second triangle: 2 moved sticks + 1 shared side
quiz.mistake: Forgets that the shared side is used by both triangles

teach.ask: Gappu has 7 twigs and wants 2 squares. Can he do it?
teach.praise: Yes! The two squares share one side: 4 + 3 = 7! Chirp!
teach.nudge: What can the two squares share?

learn.hook: A samosa, a sandwich half and a 'give way' road sign. What shape do they share?
points: Many things are triangles: a samosa's face, a sandwich half, a 'give way' road sign.
To count triangles in a pattern, count the small ones and the bigger ones they make together.
We can make different triangles with matchsticks (for example 3, 4 or 5 sticks on a side), or by joining any 3 dots on a circle.
Cut a square along both its corner-to-corner lines to get 4 triangles. Join them to make new shapes.
A 5-sided shape can be split into 3 triangles with 2 lines from one corner.

example.q: A triangle has one line from its top corner to its bottom side. How many triangles in all?

learn.reallife: Bridges and roof frames use triangles because they are very strong shapes.

games.title: Triangle or not?
items: Half a sandwich cut corner to corner

items.q: Triangles from a square cut on both diagonals
One line from the top: triangles
Triangles from 2 lines in a pentagon

quiz.q: Which object is shaped like a triangle?
options: Half of a square sandwich cut corner to corner
quiz.explain: Cutting a square corner to corner gives a shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners.

quiz.q: A square is cut along both lines from corner to corner. How many triangles?
quiz.explain: The two cuts cross in the middle and make 4 triangles.

quiz.q: A triangle with one line from its top corner to the bottom side. How many triangles in all?
quiz.explain: 2 small + 1 big = 3.

quiz.q: A pentagon has 5 sides. How many triangles do 2 lines from one corner make inside it?
quiz.explain: 2 lines from one corner split a pentagon into 3 triangles.
quiz.mistake: Thinks each line makes one triangle

quiz.q: 4 dots are on a circle. How many different triangles can you make by joining 3 of them?
quiz.explain: Leave out one dot each time. There are 4 dots to leave out, so 4 triangles.

quiz.q: Two triangles cut from a square are joined along their long sides. What shape can they make?
quiz.explain: Two halves of a square join back into the square.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a new round shape forms

quiz.q: How many sides do 3 separate triangles have in all?
A triangle is made of matchsticks of 3, 4 and 5 sticks per side. How many matchsticks in all?

teach.ask: Gappu sees a triangle with a line from its top to its base. He says there are 2 triangles. Is he right?
teach.praise: 2 small ones and the big one: 3 triangles! Chirp!
teach.nudge: Did I forget the big triangle?

learn.hook: Bangles, rotis, wheels and the moon. Round and round we go!
points: Circular objects: a bangle, a coin, a wheel, a roti, a clock face.
Trace round a bangle or a bottle cap to draw a circle.
Fold a paper plate in half, then in half again the other way. The two folds cross at the centre.
The centre is the same distance from every point on the circle.
Many games are played in a circle, like ring-a-ring-o'-roses, passing the parcel and kokla chhapaki, where children sit in a ring.

example.q: How can you find the centre of a round paper plate?
steps: Open it and fold in half another way.
The folds cross at the centre.

learn.reallife: A potter's wheel and a bullock-cart wheel turn around their centre.

games.title: Circle facts
items: It is round all the way.
Folding a plate twice helps find its centre.
The folds cross at the centre.
Tracing a bottle cap gives a circle.
The centre is closer to some edge points than others.
It is the same distance from every point.

quiz.q: Which object can you trace to draw a circle?
quiz.explain: A bangle is round, so tracing it gives a circle.

quiz.q: How many times must you fold a paper plate to find its centre?
quiz.explain: One fold gives a line through the centre. A second fold gives another line. They cross at the centre.

quiz.q: How many corners does a round roti have?
quiz.explain: A circle is round with no corners.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a circle has many corners

quiz.q: Which game is played in a circle?
quiz.explain: Children hold hands and go round in a circle.
quiz.mistake: Picks a game with a square board

quiz.q: Which is TRUE about the centre of a circle?
options: It is the same distance from every point on the circle
quiz.explain: The centre is in the middle, equally far from the whole edge.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the centre is on the edge

quiz.q: A cycle has 2 wheels. How many circles do 3 cycles' wheels make?
Which of these is NOT circular?
quiz.explain: A dice face is a square.
quiz.mistake: Thinks everything in a game is round

quiz.q: Folding a circle once along the centre makes two parts. What are they?
quiz.explain: A fold through the centre makes two equal halves.

teach.ask: Gappu has a round leaf and wants to find its middle. How can he do it?
teach.praise: Fold, fold again, and the lines cross at the centre! Chirp!
teach.nudge: How many folds do I need?

topics.title: Comparing shapes and odd one out

learn.hook: Square, rectangle, triangle, circle. Which is the odd one out? There could be more than one answer!
points: Compare shapes by the number of sides and the kind of corners.
A square and a rectangle both have 4 sides and 4 square corners. A triangle has 3 sides.
In odd one out, each shape could be different for a reason: the circle has no corners; the triangle has 3 sides.
Always give a reason for your choice.
To find the largest rectangle, compare how much space each covers, for example by counting the squares inside.

example.q: Odd one out: square, rectangle, triangle. Give a reason.
steps: Square: 4 sides. Rectangle: 4 sides. Triangle: 3 sides.
example.answer: Triangle, because it has only 3 sides

learn.reallife: Sorting shapes is how shop owners arrange tiles, boxes and plates neatly.

quiz.q: How are a square and a rectangle ALIKE?
quiz.explain: Both have 4 sides and 4 square corners.

quiz.q: How is a triangle DIFFERENT from a square?
quiz.explain: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.

quiz.q: Odd one out: circle, square, rectangle. Which is odd and why?
quiz.explain: The square and rectangle have corners. The circle has none.

quiz.q: Odd one out: square, rectangle, pentagon. Which is odd and why?
quiz.explain: The square and the rectangle have 4 sides. The pentagon has 5.
quiz.mistake: Does not compare the number of sides

quiz.q: Which rectangle is the largest? A covers 6 squares, B covers 8, C covers 4.
quiz.explain: 8 squares is the most space.

quiz.q: Rectangle A is 3 squares long and 2 wide. How many squares does it cover?
quiz.explain: 2 rows of 3 = 6 squares.

quiz.q: Shape X has 4 equal sides and 4 square corners. Shape Y has 4 sides, opposite sides equal, and 4 square corners. Both are…
quiz.explain: X is a square, which is also a rectangle. Y is a rectangle.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a square is not a rectangle

quiz.q: Odd one out: triangle, triangle, triangle, square. Why is square odd?
quiz.explain: The square has 4 sides and the rest have 3.

teach.ask: Gappu thinks the odd one out among circle, square and triangle can only be the circle. Is that right?
teach.praise: Oh! The triangle is odd too, because it has 3 sides. Each can be odd for a reason! Chirp!
teach.nudge: Can the triangle be the odd one out for some reason?

learn.hook: Two corners are given on dot paper. Where do the other two corners go?
points: To complete a rectangle with a gap, pick a piece that fills the gap exactly, with no overlap.
Game: your friend marks two opposite corners on dot paper. You draw the rectangle using them.
From opposite corners, go across from one and down from the other. Where they meet are the missing corners.
A shape can be drawn big or small, standing up or lying down. It is still the same kind of shape.

example.q: Opposite corners of a rectangle are at the top-left and bottom-right. Where are the other two?
steps: Top-right: same row as top-left, same column as bottom-right.
Bottom-left: same row as bottom-right, same column as top-left.

learn.reallife: Jigsaw puzzles and tiled floors need the right piece to fill each gap.

games.title: Gap and size facts
items: A small square drawn big is still a square.
Size does not change the shape.
A rectangle turned on its side becomes a triangle.
To fill a gap, the piece must match the gap exactly.
Two opposite corners are enough to draw a rectangle (with sides along the grid).
The other two corners are found from them.

learn.hook: Seven pieces, one square, endless pictures! A tangram can become a cat, a boat or a rocket.
points: A tangram is a square puzzle cut into 7 pieces.
It has 5 triangles, 1 square and 1 slanting 4-sided piece called a parallelogram.
The triangles come in sizes: 2 big, 1 middle-sized and 2 small.
Two small triangles can be joined to make the square piece.
We put the pieces side by side, without overlapping, to make animals, people and things.

example.q: How many of the 7 tangram pieces are NOT triangles?
steps: They are the square and the parallelogram.

learn.reallife: Tangrams are a puzzle game from long ago. You can cut one from a square of paper and play with your friends.

games.title: Tangram facts
items: 5 are triangles, but there is also a square and a parallelogram.
Two small triangles can make a square.
Put their long sides together and you get a square.
It has 2 big triangles, 1 middle-sized one and 2 small ones.
The pieces lie flat side by side without covering each other.
Two small triangles can join to make a bigger triangle.
Join them along a short side and they make the middle-sized triangle.

quiz.q: How many pieces are there in a tangram?
quiz.explain: A tangram has 7 pieces: 5 triangles, 1 square and 1 parallelogram.

quiz.q: How many of the tangram pieces are triangles?
quiz.explain: 2 big + 1 middle + 2 small = 5 triangles.

quiz.q: Which shape can you make by joining the long sides of the 2 small tangram triangles?
quiz.explain: Two small triangles joined along their long sides make a square, the same size as the square piece.
quiz.mistake: Thinks joining triangles always makes a bigger triangle

quiz.q: Kabir makes a boat using 3 triangles and 1 square. How many corners do these pieces have altogether?
quiz.explain: 3 triangles have 3 + 3 + 3 = 9 corners. The square has 4. 9 + 4 = 13.

quiz.q: Which tangram piece is NOT a triangle and NOT a square?
quiz.explain: The parallelogram is the slanting 4-sided piece. It is not a triangle or a square.
quiz.mistake: Forgets that a tangram has a slanting piece

quiz.q: Aisha used all 7 pieces to make a cat. 5 of them were triangles. How many other pieces did she use?
quiz.explain: 7 pieces in all, 5 triangles. 7 − 5 = 2 other pieces: the square and the parallelogram.
quiz.mistake: Adds 7 and 5 instead of taking away

quiz.q: When we make a tangram picture, the pieces must ___.
quiz.explain: Tangram pieces lie flat, side by side, without covering one another.
quiz.mistake: Thinks pieces can be stacked on top of each other

quiz.q: How many big triangles are there in a tangram?
quiz.explain: A tangram has 2 big triangles, 1 middle-sized triangle and 2 small triangles.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the number of big and small triangles

teach.ask: Gappu has 7 tangram pieces but doesn't know what they are. Tell him!
teach.praise: 5 triangles, a square and a parallelogram! I made a bird with them!
teach.nudge: Are all the pieces triangles? What other shapes are there?
